title: Litefleet: fail fast when the control plane fails
claim: After five failed calls in a row, Litefleet's gateway stops calling the control plane and fails fast with ErrOpen.
scenario: Find the gateway's control circuit breaker in the real C4 site, read the guard that rejects calls at the pinned commit, then watch the project's own breaker tests pass.

sources.evidence: five failures then reject without invoking dependency

narration.note: Each caption's spoken text was synthesised once; audio and per-character alignment are committed. scripts/retime.mjs times captions, steps and scene lengths from the alignment.
